🏠 Enjoy full access to this stylish city getaway, designed for comfort, relaxation, and unforgettable views. Step into your private balcony with sweeping stunning skyline and pool views. This modern living space, has everything you need for a seamless stay. 
A fully equipped kitchen, cozy bedroom, modern bathroom, in-unit washer/dryer, and a hair dryer for your convenience.

🏢Guests will be granted access to the entire unit and all of the property's amenities. Please, make yourself at home

Other things to note

Thank you for staying with us,  we truly appreciate respectful guests and look forward to hosting you!
